paragraph: Both the candidates in this election are right-**wing**. My approach to life is to just **wing** it. Was it really necessary to change the front **wing**?
english: an appendage of an animal's (bird, bat, insect) body that enables it to fly
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: كنف

paragraph: I would like to **hire** a car. He will **hire** someone who speaks English. If you won't take care of the pool, I'll **hire** someone who will.
english: to obtain the services of in return for fixed payment
arabicDesc: مثال: أود أن استأجر سيارة.

paragraph: The **actual** price was lower than I had thought. Test your theory to determine the **actual** cause. I can't confirm that that's the **actual** number of deaths.
english: relating to a person's acts or deeds
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: واقعي، فعلي

other.meaning: in action at the time being

paragraph: Our car **broke** down on our way there. A fire **broke** out near my house. A fire **broke** out last night.
english: financially ruined, bankrupt
arabicDesc: مثال: تعطلت سيارتنا في طريقنا إلى هناك.

paragraph: Could you get me a **glass** of water, please? I usually have a **glass** of milk for breakfast. He drinks a **glass** of water every morning.
english: drinking vessel — see also cup, chalice, goblet
arabicDesc: مثال: هلا جلبت لي كأسا من الماء من فضلك؟

paragraph: China isn't actually that **powerful**. Love is strong, but money is much more **powerful**. Most **powerful** is he who controls his own power.
english: having or capable of exerting power, potency or influence
arabicDesc: مثال: في حقيقة الأمر، الصين ليست قوية إلى هذه الدرجة.

paragraph: Do you think that the **prior** generations lived better? It was so very different from his **prior** life. She was in the military **prior** to becoming a teacher.
english: earlier; existing before

paragraph: Keep off the **religious** issue when talking with him. There are **religious** issues we should keep in mind. He was working with the ministry of **religious** affairs.
english: concerning religion

other.meaning: committed to the practice of religion

paragraph: You can catch different **species** of fish while fishing. I had never before seen this **species** of fish. How many animal **species** are there in the world?
english: group of plants or animals having similar appearance

paragraph: They didn't even know **whom** they were to meet. I know that boy **whom** you don't know. For **whom** have you brought the bone?
english: what person; object of a verb (accusative)
arabicDesc: مثال: هُم حتى لم يكونوا يعرفون من سيلتقون.

paragraph: All the best wishes on this **wonderful** day. Too much of a good thing is **wonderful**! This **wonderful** man saved my life.
english: tending to excite wonder
arabicDesc: مثال: اطيب التمنيات في هذا اليوم الرائع.

paragraph: Are you the one who **organized** this party? You can **organize** a fun activity for the kids. What method do you use to **organize** your files?
english: to arrange in working order
arabicDesc: مثال: أأنت من نظّم الحفلة؟

paragraph: He **proposed** that another meeting be held next Monday. The President **proposed** a new plan. He's made up his mind to **propose** to her.
english: to suggest a plan or course of action
arabicDesc: مثال: إقترح أن تعقد جلسة أخرى الإثنين المقبل.

other.meaning: to ask for someone's hand in marriage — see also ask for someone's hand in marriage

paragraph: If I were **healthy**, I would be happy. I exercise because I want to stay **healthy**. She gave birth to a **healthy** baby.
english: enjoying good health
arabicDesc: مثال: لو كنت بصحة جيدة لكنت سعيدا.

paragraph: A **secure** income is an important thing for me. They believe their country is **secure** against foreign enemies. You need to keep the keys in a **secure** place.
english: safe; also to get or make safe

paragraph: In which time **zone** does a new day begin? Will the mission reach the conflict **zone** in time? She punched the ball clear of the danger **zone**.
english: area distinguished on the basis of a particular characteristic etc
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: نطاق

other.meaning: To divide into or assign to sections or areas (verb)

paragraph: He has made a lot of **progress** in English. We make **progress** only one step at a time. Have you made much **progress** in English in America?
english: advancement to a more developed state

paragraph: Let's carry on the **discussion**. What's the difference between a **discussion** and a fight? The long **discussion** came to an end at last.
english: conversation or debate concerning a particular topic
arabicDesc: مثال: لنكمل حديثنا.

paragraph: In what hotel do you **intend** to stay? I'm sorry. I didn't **intend** to do that. I **intend** to clean my room.
english: to fix the mind upon a goal
arabicDesc: مثال: في أي فندقٍ تنوي الإقامة؟

paragraph: The city was **bombed** by enemy planes. The area around here was **bombed**. How did they know how to make the **bombs**?
english: an explosive device used or intended as a weapon, especially, one dropped from an aircraft
arabicDesc: مثال: قصفت طائرات العدوّ المدينة.

other.meaning: To attack using one or more bombs (verb)

paragraph: A **criminal** has escaped from a local prison. I don't know which room the **criminal** went into. This person always plays the role of a **criminal**.
english: person guilty of a crime, breaking the law
arabicDesc: مثال: فرّ مجرمة من سجن محلّي.

paragraph: With his new job, he's taken on more **responsibility**. We all have a **responsibility** to protect each other. In this country, people have no sense of **responsibility**.
english: the state of being responsible

paragraph: You're a **hero** in my eyes. His victory made him a **hero**. They consider him a **hero**.
english: person of great bravery
arabicDesc: مثال: أنت بطل في نظري.

paragraph: He attended the meeting as the company **representative**. I am the legal **representative** for the company. Are your opinions **representative** of those of the other students?
english: one who speaks for another
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد حضر الاجتماع كممثل للشركة.

paragraph: When is the latest **edition** of this paper out? There isn't a French **edition** of this book yet. This is a special **edition**. You can't touch it.
english: a written work edited and published, as by a certain editor or in a certain manner, or at a certain time

paragraph: It was a **quarter** past four in the morning. Who do you think will win the **quarter**-final? It's now a **quarter** past six in the evening.
english: a fourth part of something

paragraph: Police **responded** to the scene. The control tower stopped **responding**. I asked him about that, but he didn't **respond**.
english: to say something in return
arabicDesc: مثال: استجابت الشرطة و أتت إلى المكان.

paragraph: I promise that I will send you to **prison**. They don't want to go to **prison**, do they? I just got out of **prison** three months ago.
english: place of long-term confinement for those convicted of serious crimes

paragraph: My **strength** is all gone. Find the **strength** to rise every time you fall. Your love gave me the **strength** to go on.
english: quality of being strong
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد فقدت قواي كلها.

paragraph: They were watching for the **signal** to start. He didn't catch the **signal**. He crossed the street when the **signal** was red.
english: sign made to give notice
arabicDesc: مثال: كانوا يترقبون اشارة البدء.

paragraph: Parents need to **encourage** their children to read. My friends **encouraged** me to learn German. Have you ever **encouraged** your children to go on a diet?
english: mentally support or motivate
arabicDesc: مثال: على الوالدين تشجيع أبناءهم على القراءة.

paragraph: They met in a **restaurant** on the Left Bank. My father used to eat in that **restaurant**. I go to a **restaurant** every other day.
english: a place where you buy and eat meals
arabicDesc: مثال: التقيا في مطعم في الضّفّة اليسرى.

paragraph: He became a famous **actor**. I am a famous **actor**. Yesterday I met one of the most famous **actors** in the world.
english: dramatic performer — see also actress, play-actor
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد أصبح ممثلا مشهورا.

paragraph: I take light **exercise** every morning. You should rest after **exercise**. You will lose a lot of weight if you just **exercise** every day for 15 minutes.
english: physical activity intended to improve strength and fitness
arabicDesc: مثال: أقوم ببعض التمارين الخفيفة كل صباح.

other.meaning: any activity designed to develop or hone a skill or ability
To exert for the sake of training or improvement (verb)

paragraph: I got an **email** yesterday that was written in French. I sent you this **email** two weeks ago. I just wanted to check my **email**.
english: system for transmitting and receiving digital messages
arabicDesc: مثال: وصلني بريد إلكتروني الأمس مكتوب بالفرنسية.

other.meaning: message sent through an electronic system

paragraph: I can play in the **yard** all I want. We found a poor little cat in the **yard**. You can't let the dog out of the **yard**.
english: a small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building

paragraph: He was trained by an **expert**. Let's check with an **expert**. A number of **experts** attended the meeting.
english: extraordinarily capable or knowledgeable
arabicDesc: مثال: دُرب على يد خبير.

other.meaning: A person with extensive knowledge or ability in a given subject (noun)

paragraph: There was a post office on this **corner** once. The whole future is just around the **corner**. He looked at me out of the **corner** of his eye.
english: space in the angle between converging lines or walls
arabicDesc: مثال: في يوم من الأيام كان هناك مكتب بريدي على هذه الزاوية من الشارع.

paragraph: My name is known to **everybody** in my school. Why can't we go to school like **everybody**? **Everybody** knows that two and two make four.
english: all people
arabicDesc: مثال: اسمي معروف لدى الجميع في مدرستي.

paragraph: The man sitting over there is a **famous** singer. Everyone wants to meet you. You're **famous**! Lots of **famous** people come here.
english: well known
arabicDesc: مثال: الرجل الذي يجلس هناك مغن شهير.

paragraph: Our restaurant is near the **southern** bus station. Come with me to the **southern** coast of France! South Africa is the largest country in **Southern** Africa.
english: of the south
arabicDesc: مثال: يقع مطعمنا بالقرب من محطة الحافلات الجنوبية.

paragraph: **Traditional** Russian houses are made out of wood. **Traditional** Japanese sweets really do go well with Japanese tea. It is an ancient, popular and **traditional** festival.
english: of, relating to, or derived from tradition

paragraph: My boss is **twice** as old as I am. His room is **twice** as large as mine. The meeting is held **twice** a month.
english: two times
arabicDesc: مثال: رئيسي في العمل يكبرني عمراً بمرتين.

paragraph: If you find yourself in a **hole**, stop digging. There is a **hole** right there. A **hole** in one is moving on the whole.
english: hollow in some surface
arabicDesc: مثال: إذا وجدت نفسك في حفرة، توقف عن الحفر.

other.meaning: To make holes in (an object or surface) (verb)

paragraph: We **celebrate** the Star Festival in July. I have nothing to **celebrate**. Come to our place to **celebrate** the new year.
english: honour by rites, ceremonies, etc.
arabicDesc: مثال: نحن نحتفل بمهرجان النجمة في يوليو.

paragraph: He has to wait until I bring him some **warm** milk. Why is your milk **warm**? It is getting **warmer** day by day.
english: having a temperature slightly higher than usual
arabicDesc: مثال: عليه أن ينتظر حتى أحضر له بعض الحليب الساخن.

paragraph: A door must be either **shut** or open. **Shut** up and let me talk. **Shut** all the doors and windows.
english: (transitive) to close
arabicDesc: مثال: يجب أن يكون الباب إما مغلقا أو مفتوحا.

other.meaning: (intransitive) to close, to stop being open

paragraph: Are there any blue flowers out in the **wild**? The sound was probably made by a **wild** animal. It's **wild** the way the game is set up.
english: not domesticated or tamed
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: متوحش

paragraph: We need water to **survive**. I know how to **survive**. Only one person **survived** the accident.
english: to continue to live
arabicDesc: مثال: نحتاج للماء كي نعيش.

paragraph: Actually this will be my **fourth** question. And the evening and morning were the **fourth** day. The **fourth** period was moved up to the third.
english: ordinal form of the number four — see also 4th
arabicDesc: مثال: في الحقيقة، سيكون هذا سؤالي الرابع.

paragraph: A **fresh** layer of snow covered the street. I bought some **fresh** eggs which had just come from the farm. Why are you so **fresh**?
english: newly produced or obtained
arabicDesc: مثال: طبقة من الجليد غًطى الشارع.

paragraph: It's not the first time I've seen this **sentence**. Make a **sentence** with each of these words. There is a mistake in the **sentence**.
english: grammatically complete series of words consisting of a subject and predicate
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه ليست المرة الأولی التي أری فيها هذه الجملة .

other.meaning: (dated) decision or judgement of a court — see also judgment, verdict
To declare a sentence on a convicted person (verb)

paragraph: They gave him a chance to **escape**. No matter where you go, you can't **escape** yourself. She was arrested for having helped in his **escape**.
english: to get free; to free oneself
arabicDesc: مثال: أعطوه فرصة للهروب.

other.meaning: The act of leaving a dangerous or unpleasant situation (noun)

paragraph: Local **residents** are in a state of shock. A local **resident** captured the event on video. The new **resident** quickly built a good relationship with the community.
english: person living at a location or an area
arabicDesc: مثال: السكان المحليون في صدمة.

paragraph: It's going to be **weird**. The teacher was acting **weird**. I have a **weird** neighbor.
english: having an unusually strange character or behaviour
arabicDesc: مثال: سيكون غريبًا.

paragraph: Never lose **faith** in yourself. You can do everything you want to do. My **faith** helped me get through some difficult times. I have a lot of **faith** in this project.
english: a trust or confidence in the intentions or abilities of a person, object, or ideal from prior empirical evidence
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تفقد الثّقة في نفسك أبدا. بإمكانك ان تقوم بأيّ شيء تريده.

paragraph: Your mother is in **critical** condition. My mission is of **critical** importance. Today we stand at a **critical** point in history.
english: inclined to find fault or criticize
arabicDesc: مثال: والدتك في حالة حرجة.

paragraph: My cell phone has a built-in **digital** camera. This camera can take a **digital** recording for you. He does not know how to use a **digital** camera.
english: having to do with digits (fingers or toes)

paragraph: Your **mental** health is more important than your grades. His father is locked away in a **mental** hospital. Thank you for being concerned about my **mental** health.
english: of or relating to the mind or specifically the total emotional and intellectual response of an individual to external reality

paragraph: Last week, the weather was **mostly** dry and clear. It's **mostly** that area where you must pay more attention. His success was **mostly** due to good luck.
english: mainly; most of the time

paragraph: I recognized him immediately since we had **previously** met. The oceans are warming faster than scientists **previously** thought. I will be here two hours earlier than **previously** said.
english: at an earlier time
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: قبل

paragraph: Who said that? It's **totally** wrong! I didn't **totally** get the point of your question. In many respects, women and men are **totally** different.
english: completely
arabicDesc: مثال: من قال ذلك؟ إنه خطأ تمامًا!

paragraph: All the photos were posted on his **Twitter** profile. I didn't know his name, just his **Twitter** handle. In my opinion, **Twitter** is a waste of time.
english: the sound of a succession of chirps as uttered by birds

other.meaning: An online social networking and microblogging service (noun)

paragraph: To save time, we took the **plane**. Our **plane** was flying above the clouds. What time does your **plane** leave?
english: an airplane
arabicDesc: مثال: لنختصر الوقت, أستقلينا الطائرة

paragraph: The **Prime** Minister will hold a press conference tomorrow. You are no longer in the **prime** of life. The **Prime** Minister will go on the air tomorrow.
english: first in importance, degree, or rank
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: فاخر

paragraph: Only this will **ensure** that the message gets across. I can't **ensure** that she will be here tomorrow. The military must be ready to **ensure** national security.
english: to make certain that something happens

paragraph: Last year was a pretty **tough** year for us. I'm not as **tough** as everybody thinks I am. He was trying to be **tough** at all costs.
english: difficult; also strong and not easily hurt

paragraph: I could write in my **journal** for a while. Thank you for submitting your work to this **journal**. Keep a **journal** to express your thoughts and emotions.
english: a magazine about a subject; also a diary

paragraph: The teacher explained the new lesson at **length** to the students. At **length**, we reached the top of the mountain. The **length** of service for both positions is 2 years.
english: distance along the longest dimension
arabicDesc: مثال: شرحت المعلمة الدرس الجديد بإفاضة للطلاب.

paragraph: You should choose a job in **relation** to your talents and interests. Please state your opinion with **relation** to this project. I don't see any **relation** between the two problems.
english: the manner in which two things may be associated
arabicDesc: مثال: يجب عليك أن تختار وظيفة تتعلق بمواهبك واهتماماتك.

paragraph: Thank you for **understanding** me. Well, I'm pleased we could come to some **understanding**. I'm having a hard time **understanding** how this works.
english: (''uncountable'') the mental process of discernment of meaning
arabicDesc: مثال: شكرا على تفهمك لي.

paragraph: I have never seen this picture on the **net**. We remind you that our terms are 60 days **net**. The ball flew into the roof of the **net**.
english: interconnecting system

paragraph: Have you ever served as a **witness** in a court case? He gave **witness** to the truth of my statement. He came only as a **witness** to the light.
english: one who has a personal knowledge of something
arabicDesc: مثال: هل سبق لك و أن كنت شاهدا في محاكمة؟

other.meaning: attestation of a fact or event
someone called to give evidence in a court

paragraph: You were having an **affair**. I don't want to be involved in this **affair**. That guy is having an **affair** with your sister!
english: something which is done or is to be done
arabicDesc: مثال: كانت لديك علاقة غير شرعيّة.

paragraph: She put the **magazine** on the table. My mother is reading a **magazine**. The **magazine** comes out every week.
english: periodical
arabicDesc: مثال: هىَ وضعت المجلة علىَ الطاولة.

other.meaning: ammunition clip or chamber enabling multiple rounds to be held before firing

paragraph: They **inspire** each other to reach their full potential. You **inspire** those around you with your quiet grace. We may give advice, but we do not **inspire** conduct.
english: to give someone the wish or ideas to do something

paragraph: An **apple** is round in shape. You're the **apple** of my eye. He reached for the **apple**.
english: fruit of Malus domestica
arabicDesc: مثال: التفاحة دائرية الشكل.

paragraph: My **shift** ends at five. Starting next week, I'll be working the late **shift**. Usually I have a **shift** with a longer break.
english: change of workers
arabicDesc: مثال: انتهت نوبة العمل في الخامسة.

paragraph: Could you show me the way to the **port**? He wants to get off at the next **port**. My phone has a short in the charging **port**.
english: dock or harbour
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مينا

other.meaning: To carry, bear, bring, or transport. See porter (verb)

paragraph: I **prefer** going out to staying at home. You **prefer** patients who can't talk, don't you? Some people like cats, and others **prefer** dogs.
english: to be in the habit of choosing something rather than something else
arabicDesc: مثال: أفضل الخروج على البقاء في البيت.

paragraph: She suggested that we go to the **theater**. I sat behind a very tall person at the **theater**. This building is not a movie **theater**.
english: place or building
arabicDesc: مثال: اقترحت علينا الذهاب إلى السينما.

paragraph: How many people did you **invite** to your party? We have come to **invite** you to dinner. I would like to **invite** you to dinner.
english: ask for the presence or participation of someone
arabicDesc: مثال: كم شخصًا دعوت إلى الحفلة؟

paragraph: He didn't have the **desire**. We **desire** to remove a weight from the heart. He has no **desire** to go dancing with her.
english: wish for earnestly
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يكن راغبا في ذلك.

paragraph: I have an **African**-American neighbor. There is an **African** Studies program at my university. Youth protests are taking place in some **African** countries.
english: of or pertaining to Africa
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا لدي جار أفريقي-أمريكي.

paragraph: I did not have **sexual** relations with that woman. It's normal to have **sexual** fantasies in a relationship. Have you and her had a **sexual** relationship?
english: arising from the fact of being male or female

paragraph: We need to make a **survey** of local opinion. I want to start with doing a small **survey**. What are you going to make a **survey** of?
english: an examination of the opinions, information of a group
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: استبانة

paragraph: The **accident** happened right in front of my eyes. There has been an **accident** at the site. You had better not tell your father about the **accident**.
english: unexpected event with negative consequences
arabicDesc: مثال: وقع الحادث أمام عيني.

paragraph: The **task** is of great importance to them. The man did his **task**. Did you do your **tasks**?
english: piece of work done as part of one’s duties
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا العمل هام جدا بالنسبة لهم.

paragraph: I did everything I could to **obtain** this price. She tried to **obtain** a ticket for the concert. I was able to **obtain** a personally signed ball.
english: to get hold of

paragraph: Our **bond** is built on trust, not financial gain. What's the difference between a stock and a **bond**? We **bond** with everyone we have a relationship with.
english: a close connection between people; also a type of loan

paragraph: One **billion** people speak English. The population of the world now is about 3 **billion**. There are eight **billion** people living in the world.
english: a thousand million (1,000,000,000); a milliard
arabicDesc: مثال: مليار شخص يتكلمون الإنجليزية.

paragraph: The **rain** has let up, so we can begin. I love the sound of **rain** on the roof. I don't think that it will **rain** tomorrow.
english: condensed water from a cloud
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد توقف المطر, لذا يمكننا البدء.

other.meaning: To have rain fall from the sky (verb)

paragraph: You don't need to send detailed notes to your **boss**. You talk as if you were the **boss**. The **boss** gave us all a day off.
english: supervisor
arabicDesc: مثال: لست بحاجة لترسل رسائل مفصّلة لرئيسك.

paragraph: Millions of trees have been cut down for **fuel**. **Fuel** economy is a big advantage of this car. They are only adding **fuel** to the fire.
english: substance consumed to provide energy through combustion, or through chemical or nuclear reaction

paragraph: Every cloud has a **silver** lining. We all knew that gold was heavier than **silver**. Do you think this **silver** is real or fake?
english: a lustrous, white, metallic element, atomic number 47, atomic weight 107.87, symbol Ag
arabicDesc: مثال: رب ضارّةٍ نافعة.

paragraph: The baby is **sucking** his finger. If you quit when you **suck**, you'll **suck** forever. Do not let her use you and **suck** you dry.
english: an instance of drawing something into one's lungs by inhaling or into one's mouth by suction
arabicDesc: مثال: الطفل يرضع أصبعه.

other.meaning: To use the mouth and lips to pull in (a liquid, especially milk from the breast) (verb)

paragraph: I wish there was more **variety** in my work. You can catch a **variety** of fish while fishing. We may collect a **variety** of information about you.
english: a deviation or difference

paragraph: Did you have an **argument**? He got into an **argument**. She had an **argument** with her brother at home.
english: a fact or statement used to support a proposition
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تشاجرت؟

other.meaning: 8.1. variable that is being passed to a function

paragraph: Even today, the **temperature** is below zero. Now, I'll take your **temperature**. My mother took my **temperature**.
english: a measure of cold or heat
arabicDesc: مثال: حتى اليوم درجة الحرارة تحت الصفر.

paragraph: We take photos with the trees in the **background**. Her dress has white spots on a blue **background**. The picture would look better on a bright **background**.
english: one's social heritage, or previous life
